verdict.rationale: Stagehand is itself a programmatic SDK. Its documented public API covers `act`, `extract` (with typed output shapes), `observe`, and `agent`, plus reference pages such as `BrowserClipboard`, across TypeScript, Python, and Go. It also adds AI-oriented access via an MCP/stdio integration, an llms.txt index and AI-rules docs, and community users describe building with it hands-on. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed paths 404), thin independent corroboration of API completeness and stability.
